blocks.text: Jared Bahay delivered another spirited performance along with Kieffer Alas for Ateneo de Manila University, but their efforts went unrewarded as the Blue Eagles suffered an 82-74 defeat to the University of the Philippines (UP) in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Men's Basketball Tournament on Saturday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum....
